system/io.vectory.agent = {
	active count = 1
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.vectory.agent.plist
	type = LaunchDaemon
	state = running

	program = /usr/local/bin/vectory
	arguments = {
		/usr/local/bin/vectory
		run
		--state-dir
		/Library/Application Support/Vectory/agent
	}

	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	environment = {
		XPC_SERVICE_NAME => io.vectory.agent
	}

	domain = system
	username = _vectory
	minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 330
	runs = 1
	pid = 4242
	immediate reason = inefficient
	forks = 0
	execs = 1
	initial spawn type = daemon (3)

	properties = keepalive | runatload | inferred program
}
